service.en: Public school certificate issuance and attestation
service.ar: إصدار واعتماد شهادة مدرسية للتعليم الحكومي
service.ur: سرکاری اسکول سرٹیفکیٹ کا اجراء اور تصدیق

about: Get a new or replacement school certificate for a public school student, Grades 1 to 12.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Public school certificate issuance and attestation. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Covers public school students in all cycles for use inside the UAE
Paper originals (up to 3 copies) are for Grade 12 only, for use abroad after MOFA attestation
fees: AED 15 delivery if a paper copy is requested
Optional MOFA attestation AED 150 plus AED 150 for the embassy
channels: MOE website or smart app, sign in with UAE PASS
